mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic_material_links (user_id, course_id, topic_id, material_id, section_id, role, locator, origin, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{topicId}, #{materialId}, #{sectionId}, #{role}, #{locator}, #{origin}, 'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'ACTIVE', role = VALUES(role), locator = COALESCE(VALUES(locator), locator), link_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(link_id)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM topic_material_links WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY topic_id ASC, link_id ASC
SELECT * FROM topic_material_links WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND topic_id IN #{id} ORDER BY topic_id ASC, link_id ASC
SELECT * FROM topic_material_links WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY link_id ASC
SELECT * FROM topic_material_links WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY link_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE topic_material_links SET status = 'REMOVED' WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE topic_material_links SET status = 'REMOVED' WHERE link_id = #{linkId} AND user_id = #{userId}
